contract.idempotent_exact_duplicate: Registering the same plugin, event and callback repeatedly does not create duplicate listener entries
contract.owner_isolation: The same callback may be registered independently by different plugins
contract.event_isolation: The same callback may be registered independently for different events
contract.callback_isolation: Different callbacks remain independently registered for the same plugin and event
contract.delivery_order: Callbacks are delivered in registry order
contract.unregister_isolation: Unregister removes only the matching plugin, event and callback registration
contract.registry_integrity: Duplicate registration boundaries do not corrupt listener registry structure
contract.emit_success: EventBus.emit() remains successful across duplicate-registration boundary cases
contract.permission_enforcement: EventBus callback operations require the events permission
